name: Ashley
source:
Ashley is 4'11 with natural brown hair (dyes it blonde) and has purple eyes due to being 6% dark elf. She grew up as an only child living with her mother and father, in a small trailer home. Ashley's childhood was spent with a welfare elf named Ms. Ren, who took care of her. Ms. Ren was soon taken away due to Ashley being at the age limit for care, when she began school. Ashley struggled in school, trying to make friends, and relationships. At 19, Ashley was kicked out by her father, as her mother was fired from her job and they could only afford the next few months of rent without her. After stealing her mother's credit card and running away, she discovered the hotel.

Ashley hopes to have twelve children and raise all of them lovingly. She has put a huge amount of thought and planning into this goal. Ashley wants their names to be Ash/Ashe, Chloe, Felix, Jason, Kiara, Kylie, Lilly and Amy. She leaves the rest up to the player, and wants one named after him. She hopes to have a unique story for each child's conception. Ashley has also always wanted a sister.

Ashley's favourite colour is yellow, and her favourite food is ramen. She likes hamsters, strawberry flavours, cheese pizza, and enjoys gory, horror, action and sci-fi movies. Her stalking skills have led her to be able to use a license plate to find the full name of its owner.
